name: novak-monorepo
description: Novak: a photo-sharing app whose captions are searchable by meaning (Express + MongoDB + BullMQ + FastAPI + Qdrant)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@novak/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace=@novak/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@novak/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@novak/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@novak/api && npm run build --workspace=@novak/web
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d mongo redis qdrant
scripts.infra:all: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.override.yml --profile app up -d

author: Abhishek
